title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-jjhj: schc/fragment.rs from_bytes called with 2 args at line 776 but signature takes 1
description: FragmentReceiver::receive_bytes line 776 calls `Fragment::from_bytes(data, &mut tile)` passing a tile output buffer, but the live Fragment::from_bytes signature at line 167 takes only `data: &[u8]`. The deleted dead code expected the 2-arg form (unpacking into out buffer). The call site and function signature are mismatched. Fix must align both: either add output buffer parameter to from_bytes with bit-unpacking, or remove the tile buffer from the call site and use the borrowed-from-data approach.
